_comment: Smoke test for the runner: one Sonnet job with no MCP that writes a one-word file and
reports what it can see. Verifies, in order: the agent ran from the launch folder, wrote
the output by relative-to-run-folder path, saw no mcp__* tools (strict MCP dropped the
user-level connectors), and left no transcript in any project dir. Run it twice: the
second run must launch nothing (the ledger shows the job succeeded). To run it again
after a runner change, give the job a new id (e.g. smoke-sonnet-2026-09-10).

jobs.item: the harness itself — one file write and a tool inventory
jobs.instructions: This is a harness smoke test. Do exactly two things. First, write a file at the output path whose entire content is the single word OK followed by a newline. Second, in your reply, list the names of every tool available to you, one per line, and state the current working directory if you know it. Do not read any other file and do not write anywhere else.
